answer: Give each admission a two-phase gate. First a sponsor posts slashable collateral and parks the applicant on a public terrace where peers can challenge the claim for a full cooling window. Second the applicant must reveal a one-time walnut of hardware-bound stake that cannot be reused across identities, then keep a live work signal that matches the sponsor's attested pattern. Failed challenges slash both parties, so farms cannot cheaply mint parallel selves.
